name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Hormuz attacks; US strike decision due
summary: Trump says a decision on resuming strikes is near; Iran says it downed a US drone and more tankers hit mines
state: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they shot down a US drone over Qeshm Island and that two tankers struck mines on 6 Nov, and a seafarer was killed on a tanker hit off Qatar on 5 Nov (Al Jazeera; gCaptain). President Trump said he would decide 'very soon' between a deal and new strikes, and US Central Command is preparing options (CBS News; Fox News). Active state-on-state hostilities and attacks on shipping meet the Alert line.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf states. Flights over the region may be rerouted at short notice.
rubric_hit: Alert: active strikes between states and attacks on Gulf shipping

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Iran war live: IRGC says US drone downed, tankers hit

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
